task_meta.title: Improve an ugly, inaccessible signup form

judge.reasons: Clean centred card with clear heading, visible labels, dominant full-width button and ~48px tall inputs; works at 390px without overflow. Hint text is small. The screenshots don't show error, submitting or success states, so those can't be confirmed.

claim_text:
I've redesigned the signup page and tested it in headless Chrome at 390px and 320px wide and on desktop, in light and dark mode. Everything on your must-have list works, and there were no `alert()`s or console errors.

**How it looks now**
- A centred card using the system font,
